## About
My City Auto Care & Tire is the tire and repair shop on Harlem Ave in Bridgeview. We work on all makes and models, from routine maintenance and diagnostics to brakes, transmissions and climate control.
Our technicians take the time to understand your vehicle, explain what it needs, and help you decide without unnecessary repairs or surprise costs. Need tires? We carry a wide selection and will help you find the right fit for your vehicle, how you drive and what you want to spend.
Drivers from Bridgeview and nearby communities have given us a 4.6 rating across 342 Google reviews. Call us, stop in, or schedule online.

## Services
- Tires: A wide selection of quality tires matched to your vehicle, driving needs and budget.
- Brake repair and maintenance: Routine maintenance, diagnostics and brake repairs to keep your vehicle running safely.
- Engine diagnostics and performance: Hearing a strange noise or seeing a warning light? We'll find the cause and explain it before any work starts.

## FAQ
Q: Can I pick out my tires before my appointment?
A: Yes. Customers often come in ahead of time to choose tires so they're in stock and ready when the appointment comes around.

Q: How do I book service?
A: Give us a call, stop by the shop, or schedule your service online.

## What customers say
- "Honesty, Integrity, and Exceptional Service,  A Repair Shop That Truly Puts Customers First!

I can't say enough good things about this shop! I recently brought my vehicle in after hearing an unusual noise coming from the engine area. I wasn't sure what was causing it, so I took it in to have them take a look.

After an initial inspection, they believed the water pump was going bad. They provided me with a quote, and I agreed to the repair.

When I returned to pick up my vehicle, I was surprised to discover that my bill was half of the original estimate! Naturally, I asked why. They explained that after further inspection, they determined the problem wasn't the water pump itself but simply the water pump drive belt pulley. They replaced the pulley, and the noise was completely gone.

What impressed me most was their honesty and integrity. They could have easily replaced the entire water pump and charged me the higher amount I had already agreed to pay. I would have never known the difference. Instead, they did the right thing, fixed only what was actually wrong, and saved me a significant amount of money.

My vehicle is older and has its share of issues, so finding a shop I can trust means everything. Their workmanship is excellent, their prices are fair, and their integrity is second to none.

It's rare to find a business that puts honesty and customer trust ahead of making an extra dollar. They have earned my complete trust, and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for a reliable, honest, and knowledgeable auto repair shop. Truly outstanding service!" (Charles, 5/5)
